purpose: Named exterior collision regions for prototype shuttle ship-world physics and later exterior traversal validation.
notes: This contract replaces temporary hardcoded underside skids in PrototypeShuttleDebugLoader.
Regions marked ship_world_physics are intended for rigid-body contact with planets, platforms, terrain, and large obstacles.
Regions marked player_walkable may be used for player traversal validation. This first pass intentionally keeps support skids separate from the central ramp path.

regions.fit_target: left lower belly outside the central ramp/cargo traversal path
regions.rationale: Provides stable platform/planet contact without placing a broad blocker through the interior or ramp.

regions.fit_target: right lower belly outside the central ramp/cargo traversal path
regions.rationale: Pairs with the left skid to support liftoff and landed state while leaving the central ramp route clear.

regions.fit_target: aft underside belly near the cargo volume tail
regions.rationale: Adds a third contact region so the ship can rest with less rocking than two long side skids alone.

regions.fit_target: lower neck area forward of the cargo ramp aperture
regions.rationale: Gives low-speed nose/neck contact a named region without crossing the open ramp.
